The '''TZ-2''' was a [[Hoverbike/Legends|hoverbike]] produced by [[Joko]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] and [[Galactic War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]].

==Behind the scenes==
The Joko TZ-2 is a mount that was first added to the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' as part of the Master's Shadow Pack.
